documents.title: Application (child protection)
documents.text:
[Page 1]
The Society claims: an order that the child be placed in extended society care.
Grounds: The child is in need of protection under clause 74 (2) (b) of the Act.
[Page 2]
Facts relied on:
1. On January 9, 2026, police attended the home after a neighbour reported shouting. No charges were laid.
2. The parents completed a parenting program in March 2026, as requested by the Society.
3. The Society has no other child protection history with this family.
